source_origin: Original JavaScript implementation created for this packet from the standard LeetCode problem specification; uncertain premium contracts were cross-checked against LeetCode/LeetCode Wiki. No external solution implementation was copied. Gamma assignment-packet provenance and contract verification remain pending.
normalization: Defines the standard LeetCode entry signature `function removeElements(head, val)` as a self-contained synchronous function. No Gamma-specific wrapper or multi-parameter normalization was applied.
numeric_semantics: Uses strict equality for node-value comparison and performs no arithmetic on values.
mutation_contract: Mutates next pointers in place and reuses surviving nodes; removed nodes become unreachable from the returned head.
interface_support: Supports the standard ListNode interface through val and next fields; the temporary sentinel is not returned.
input_domain: Finite acyclic singly linked lists and a comparison value, including a null head.
